# Segment Images

> 🤖 *AI Drafted (Not reviewed)*

Detect foreground document regions and emit cropped segment derivatives.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Tool id | `segment_images` |
| Category | transform |
| Uses a language model | no |
| Needs a generative model | no |

| Item handling | batch |

## What it reads

| Port | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Files (`files`) | `files` | yes | Image files to segment. |
| Documents (`documents`) | `json` | no | Document metadata for preview-editor edit-chain updates. |

## What it emits

| Port | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Segment Files (`output_files`) | `files` | — | Cropped segment image files. |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `compression_quality` | integer | 90 | JPEG/WebP compression quality. |
| `max_segments` | integer | 20 | Maximum number of regions to emit. |
| `method` | string | foreground | Segmentation method. One of: foreground, page. |
| `min_area` | integer | 100 | Minimum segment area in pixels. |
| `output_dir` | string | — | Optional output directory. Defaults to a temp directory. |
| `output_format` | string | png | Derived segment image format. One of: jpg, png, tiff, webp. |
| `threshold` | integer | 28 | Foreground threshold for document-region detection. |
